name: @gcu/strata
description: An auditable, reactive, column-oriented table working model: an immutable typed-columnar base + a sparse value-patch overlay (non-destructive editing, recoverable provenance), reactive derived columns (JS formulas), a sort/filter view pipeline, group-by aggregation, and a native .strata zip document. CSV ingest is recon-injectable. Zero hard dependencies; renders via @gcu/loom.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
